title: DC microgrid twin: process, sensor or model?
description: A four-bus DC microgrid twin that tells a loose joint or a degraded converter from a drifting or noisy sensor from a fast model outside its domain, with whitened physics residuals, a likelihood ratio per fault, a Kalman filter and isolability angles; a PINN fast model against a data-only network and POD + GP at equal budget; confusion matrix on controlled cases.
methods: DC power flow (droop, MPPT, constant-power load)

metrics.name: cases_with_false_alarm
metrics.how: alarm before the fault, or any alarm on a healthy case

metrics.name: smallest_isolation_angle
metrics.how: median over 64 operating points, closest pair of fault hypotheses

metrics.name: pinn_box_inside_error_N8
metrics.how: median RMS error on 200 held-out points, 8 labels, median over 3 seeds

metrics.name: mlp_data_inside_error_N8
metrics.how: median RMS error on 200 held-out points, 8 labels, median over 3 seeds

metrics.name: pod_gp_inside_error_N8
metrics.how: median RMS error on 200 held-out points, 8 labels, median over 3 seeds

checks.name: energy balance of the reference simulator
